content.short: Quicksilver is a layer 1 blockchain with a liquid staking protocol.
content.description: Quicksilver enables you to liquid stake Cosmos assets with any validator you choose, and in return you receive liquid-staked assets (qASSETs) that you can use for swapping, pooling, or lending, while your original stake continues earning staking APY from securing the network. This makes Quicksilver the only liquid-staking protocol that lets you select your own validator and vote with liquid-staked assets, combining active participation with flexible liquidity.
